description: One streamed Gemini answer with a reasoning part, traced by OpenInference.
notes: OpenInference records message content by default, and this scenario sets no content-capture environment variable. The mock waits 120 ms before the first chunk and splits reasoning and text into 4 chunks each. The span has no timing attribute. Prompt 48 is copied. Completion is 20, candidatesTokenCount 14 plus thoughtsTokenCount 6, and completion_details.reasoning is 6. The reasoning text is one message_content of type reasoning. output.value keeps candidatesTokenCount 14 and thoughtsTokenCount 6, and includes sdk_http_response headers; the mock pins Date so that string stays stable. prices.json has no Gemini model row.
